package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for rows_iterated_without_rows_err_check: Rows iterated with Next() but without a visible final Rows.Err() check.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
type Rule393PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario393Positive(db *sql.DB) ([]Rule393PositiveRecord, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var results []Rule393PositiveRecord
	for rows.Next() {
		var rec Rule393PositiveRecord
		rows.Scan(&rec.ID, &rec.Name)
		results = append(results, rec)
	}
	return results, nil
}
